name: Exchange-Open Vol Steps
description: Tested whether the Tokyo, Shanghai/Hong Kong and London stock-market opens are volatility jumps that Kalshi's 15-minute crypto prices miss, the way they miss the 9:30 New York open. They aren't: Tokyo has a small vol step but the cheap-underdog effect flips sign between halves; Hong Kong and London show no vol step.
hypothesis: Tokyo (00:00 UTC), Shanghai/HK (01:30 UTC) and London (08:00 London time) open at fixed local times; if crypto vol steps up at those opens like at 9:30 ET, a Kalshi quoter pricing off calm pre-open vol underprices the move and the underdog in the open window is cheap. Wrong if there's no vol step on the exchange's own clock, log(iv/rv_fut) there isn't low, or the underdog at next real fills after fee isn't positive in both halves on two coins.
next: Rejected at research. The screen's side finding (lower iv/rv in windows starting on the hour) became strategies/hour-calm/.
